## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from the latest `main`, one topic only
- [ ] Backend: `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Frontend: `npm run lint`, `npm run build` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New or changed endpoint: validator, test, frontend service/types and `CLAUDE.md` updated
- [ ] Rule enforced by the database: integration test added in `backend/tests-int`
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or uploaded files committed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (English and RTL if relevant)
